cohort: The study included 112 patients who underwent either elective or emergency caesarean sections at the department of OBG, AIMS, Belluar.
finding: Immediate and delayed postoperative complications were found to be similar between elective and emergency caesarean sections, but morbidity and mortality were higher in the emergency caesarian section group.
mod_finding: Morbidity and mortality were observed to be higher in patients who underwent emergency caesarean sections compared to those undergoing elective caesarean sections.
